claims.statement: Classroom enables assignment invitation URLs by default; while enabled students can accept and submit. Sharing through an LMS, course site or other posting channel is possible, not necessarily safe for every audience. Students already having accepted a classroom assignment can also navigate within Classroom. Default enablement is not enrollment verification or evidence of an actual URL's enabled state.

Anyone possessing an assignment invitation URL can accept and associate a personal account with a roster identifier, so sharing requires caution. Possession and roster association do not prove intended student identity, authorization or consent; an LMS posting does not automatically remove bearer-link exposure.

The autograding dropdown chooses a grading method through Add test under Add autograding tests. Selection is configuration, not a saved test, executed grading, adequate coverage or safe command approval.
